description: Owned original Call of Duty 4 content

sources.instructions: Obtain the original 2007 Call of Duty 4, not the remaster. Copy main/*.iwd and every multiplayer fastfile under zone/. A legacy tree uses fileSysCheck.cfg plus main/localized_*.iwd. A current Steam tree uses zone/english/localized_common_mp.ff instead. Do not replace existing server.cfg. Campaign fastfiles and client binaries are not part of the dedicated install.

Obtain the original 2007 Call of Duty 4, not the remaster. Steam app 7940 supplies main/iw_*.iwd and zone/english multiplayer fastfiles, including localized_common_mp.ff. It does not ship fileSysCheck.cfg or localized_*.iwd. Managed import keeps every mp_*.ff map and the shared multiplayer fastfiles, and omits campaign fastfiles, movies, and client binaries. A legacy tree may still provide fileSysCheck.cfg and main/localized_*.iwd.

manual_reason: Import requires a complete compatible distribution and manual staging. See assets requirements for this game.
